description: Sends ONE approved, released payment of a run through the business's own connected rail account (sandbox), with an idempotency key; without connection_id it reads the submission's status. Refused unless approved and within the connection's cap. Production execution waits on an authorised provider agreement.

access_key.description: The router key that made the run.

account.description: The payee account the person approved, to match.

connection_id.description: Your connected rail account to send through (from connect_rail_account). Omit to read the submission's status.

payment_id.description: The approved payment in the run, e.g. 'p_001'.

name: submit_payment
title: Submit an approved payment (sandbox)
